svg.aria-label: A loop drawn in pencil: start a small task, wait a minute, a small win, and then one more, arrowing back to the start. The loop goes round several times, getting later each time: 9pm, 10:30pm, midnight. A single exit arrow leaves the loop, labelled a stop time you chose earlier, pointing to a bed.
svg.text: the loop has no natural stopping point
decide where the exit is before the evening starts, not at 11pm.
